column1: # Every upstream file tuxcraft downloads (outside distro repositories), pinned with its SHA-256.
# Read by lib/pins.sh. Do not edit hashes by hand: run scripts/update-pins.sh.
#   track:  latest:OWNER/REPO       follow the repository's latest GitHub release
#           commit:OWNER/REPO@REF   follow the newest commit of a branch (raw files)
#           fixed                   only change by hand (then the script refreshes the hash)
#   url:    {v} = version as tagged, {V} = version without a leading "v"
#           several URLs separated by " | ": the script keeps the first that exists
# Catppuccin cursor sets (tux-cursor): one row per .zip of the release, added by the script.
# Bootstrap of Debian / Void from a host that is not Debian / Void (the tuxcraft ISO, for one).
